description.value: The Dayton Audio SS15-22 Signature Series 15" Subwoofer strikes the perfect balance between extreme low-frequency extension and versatile enclosure performance. Designed for high-output systems, the SS15-22 combines a rigid anodized aluminum cone, dual-spider suspension, and a massive FEA-optimized motor structure to deliver clean, controlled bass even at maximum excursion. With its 3" 4-layer copper voice coil on a vented aluminum former, the SS15-22 can handle up to 1,100 watts RMS while maintaining thermal stability and resisting power compression. Whether used in DSP assisted sealed or high output bass reflex enclosures, this driver provides the output and precision needed for any subwoofer system where power, control, and durability are essential. Product Highlights Rigid anodized aluminum cone with indexed edge for pistonic accuracy and reduced resonance Aluminum shorting sleeve, ring, and pole cap ensure linear inductance and ultra-low distortion FEA-optimized motor with triple-stacked magnets delivers exceptional strength and symmetry at high excursion 3" 4-layer copper voice coil on a vented aluminum former for superior power handling and cooling Dual spider suspension with stitched tinsel leads for precise pistonic motion and extreme durability Extensive venting through cone, pole piece, spider, and gap minimizes compression during long sessions

model.value: SS15-22 15" Signature Series DVC Subwoofer 2 Ohms per Coil
